conf.description: Cribl Stream internal-access (access.log/ui-access.log/cribl.log auth events merged on log.file.path): event.outcome derived from the exact (message, level) literal tokens the vendor publishes (no substring match), user string/object type-collision resolved before it can reach Elastic, provider host/port split, LDAP sub-status code extracted, stack trace capped and NUL-stripped.

conf.comment: cribl-internal/access/json. Three Leader-side files (access.log, ui-access.log, cribl.log) share one JSON envelope, discriminated by log.file.path. No outcome field exists; event.outcome comes only from exact-equality matches on the vendor's literal message tokens ('Successful login'/'Failed login'/'Authentication Provider Error'), never substring, since 'Failed login' and the fallback record both contain 'login'. user is a string on login records but {dn,memberOf} object on LDAP search records - resolved by typeof BEFORE rename so an object can never land in user.name and break the mapping. method/url are PLACEHOLDER key names per the work order - schema unpublished. provider's ldap:<host>:<port> is split; details.stack is capped+control-char-stripped; details.message's LDAP data-<hex> code is extracted.

functions.description: three-branch envelope, exact-token outcome rule, user type-collision, and placeholder-key caveats

compute _time (never @timestamp), the exact-token event.outcome/event.category, the type-safe user.name/cribl.user.dn split, provider host/port split, sanitized+capped+flagged stack trace, and the vendor-documented empty-group-mapping alert flag - all read from ORIGINAL field names before rename
extract the LDAP AcceptSecurityContext sub-status code (the 'data 52e' style token) that distinguishes bad password from disabled/expired account, per recommendations.direct.cribl

batch rename every clean-identifier/genuinely-nested field to its ECS or cribl.* target; username and user (handled above) are mutually exclusive per record type, same for groups/user.roles vs the LDAP-search-only fields
event.dataset (no hyphen), cleanup of the raw time/user/details originals fully consumed above - log.file.path is left as-is (already correctly named, used only for branching, not renamed)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
